Built to Last

Why Choose Fairmont Flooring

We don't believe in rushing installations, cutting corners or compromising on materials to win work. We focus on quality products, proper subfloor preparation, skilled workmanship and attention to detail.

  • Preparation First

    Every subfloor is checked for level and moisture, and prepared properly before a board goes down.

  • Precise Setting Out

    Herringbone patterns aligned and borders balanced, with clean cuts at every doorway and threshold.

  • 12 Month Guarantee

    Every job is covered by our 12 month guarantee on all work.

  • Supply and Fit

    We supply the flooring and fit it, so the whole job is straightforward from the first visit to the last trim.

  • Local to Aberdeen

    Based in Aberdeen and working across Aberdeenshire, with Dundee covered too.

About Us

The Team Behind Fairmont Flooring

Fairmont Flooring was set up with a clear aim: to bring high-quality flooring, exceptional workmanship and a professional customer experience to homeowners throughout Aberdeen and Aberdeenshire. Building on our experience in the property improvement industry, we moved into specialist flooring to offer the same attention to detail, reliability and high standards.

We focus on quality rather than quantity: engineered wood, luxury LVT, herringbone and bespoke flooring. Having work done in your home takes trust, so we are reliable, respectful and keep you informed at every stage, from choosing the right floor to the final finishing details.

Sean McPhersonOwner, Fairmont Flooring
